description: Defines the BasicCodeModules class, a concrete implementation of the CodeModules interface used to manage code modules loaded into a process, including methods for accessing modules by address, sequence, or index, and copying module data.

classes.name: BasicCodeModules
classes.description: A concrete implementation of the CodeModules interface that manages a collection of CodeModule objects loaded into a process.

methods.name: module_count
methods.description: Returns the number of code modules.

methods.name: GetModuleForAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the code module corresponding to a specific address.

methods.name: GetModuleAtSequence
methods.description: Retrieves a code module at a specific sequence number.

methods.name: GetModuleAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a code module at a specific index.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the CodeModules collection.
